# WO-203: Refresh the guides index and article template
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Make guides easier to browse and read while preserving source attribution and factual accuracy.

## Acceptance criteria
- Refresh the guides index and shared article template with the reviewed scoped components.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Preserve existing article text, citations, sources, metadata, and internal links unless a factual issue is reported for owner decision.
- Add focused built-output coverage for index cards, article headings, source links, and navigation.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit each claim against D8; flag unsupported claims. Do not rewrite article claims.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/guides/index.astro`
- `web/src/pages/guides/[slug]/index.astro`
- `web/src/pages/guides/get-your-phone-number-off-people-search-sites/index.astro`
- `web/src/pages/guides/help-a-parent-remove-their-information/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_guides_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No guide content data, sources, site-wide navigation/footer, global styles, shared tokens, CSP, or dependencies. The two named guide routes are standalone pages, not rendered by `[slug]`.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_guides_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_guides_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-207 is integrated on a main containing reviewed foundation. Guides precede the developer pages.

## Notes and decisions
Do not rewrite article claims or remove citations to make the layout fit. Escalate any content issue.
